scale.source: National Insurance (Collection of Contributions) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2023 (S.R.O. 43 of 2023) Part III: maximum insurable earnings '$5,200 per month', x 12
scale.basis: National Insurance (Collection of Contributions) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2023 (S.R.O. 43 of 2023) Part III: maximum insurable earnings '$5,200 per month', x 12. A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act' identified as Cap. 149: deduction 36,000 (s. 42A as amended by S.R.O. 1 of 2014); 10 % on the first 24,000 of chargeable income and 28 % above (S.R.O.s 1/2014, 2/2017, 25/2018); NI employee 6 % in 2025 to 5,200 a month (S.R.O. 43 of 2023), nil from age 60.
